about: What `omega hub new <id> --kind <kind>` fills in: files come from base/, then the kind's own folder (same names replace); these values replace the {{placeholders}}.

app.title: A starter app
app.tagline: A front desk that answers opening-hours questions from a tool, ready to put behind a page.

agent.title: A starter agent
agent.tagline: One agent with one tool that answers opening-hours questions in one sentence.

team.title: A starter team
team.tagline: A starting point for a team of agents: one front-desk agent with a tool, ready to grow.

workflow.title: A starter workflow
workflow.tagline: A starting point for a workflow: one agent step that calls a tool and answers.

skill.title: A starter skill
skill.tagline: A skill pack with one SKILL.md that tells an agent how to write release notes.

plugin.title: A starter plugin
plugin.tagline: A plugin that declares one MCP server with a greet tool, installed switched off.

mcp.title: A starter MCP server
mcp.tagline: An MCP server over stdio with one greet tool, and a client that calls it.
